text:
maddie: Hey team, Omnifreight asked for a joint POC runbook + costing estimate. They want SSO + VPC peering and a 99.9% latency SLA window. Can we scope asap?
raj: Quick q — do they need Dedicated or Private for data residency?
elena: They're EU-only for now, but prefer our Dedicated offering with tenant isolation. No on-prem.
claire: Ok, Dedicated + VPC peering sounds right. Blocker: their security team requires an RSA-signed SAML cert and an ISA questionnaire answered by Monday.
tom: Re: pricing — for a 2-week POC with steady 200 rps token throughput, estimate ~ 6 dedicated GPUs with burst to 8. I'll draft numbers.
maddie: Thanks. Can we confirm networking needs? Which ports, IP ranges, and egress policy?
claire: They want egress blocked except to our telemetry endpoints + S3. Need outbound to 52.200.0.0/16 and 34.210.0.0/16. Also allow TCP 443 to our control plane.
raj: For SSO, send them metadata XML. We require SP-initiated SAML, ACS: https://dedicated-<tenant>.redwood/api/saml/acs, issuer urn:redwood:dedicated. They asked about signed assertions — we support both signed and unsigned, prefer signed.
elena: They'll want demonstration of KMS integration for key rotation. Can we provide an architecture sketch showing HSM-backed keys?
tom: Yes. Use KMS-HSM via our Private KMS connector; for Dedicated we can enable customer-managed keys. I'll attach diagram later.
claire: Security questionnaire — I've pulled the standard ISA + SOC answers. Omnifreight added questions about token retention and KV cache persistence. We must confirm we don't persist raw prompts.
raj: Confirmed: we persist minimal telemetry + embeddings hashes per contract; KV cache is ephemeral and not logged. I'll add exact retention windows.
maddie: Ops-bot, can you provision a staging tenant for omnifreight-demo and set a 2-week TTL?
ops-bot: Creating tenant... request queued. Estimated completion: 20 minutes. Tenant id: demo-omnifreight-2955.
ops-bot: Tenant demo-omnifreight-2955 provisioned. Credentials shared in secure channel.
elena: Great. Next: pricing slide for partnership — include discounted POC rate (30% off list) and an uplift if they go to annual committed Dedicated. Also add line-item for professional services (sso + networking config).
tom: I created a quick cost calc: base infra: $5,400/day (6 gpus avg) -> 14 days -> $75,600. POC discount 30% -> $52,920. PS (2 eng days on onboarding + docs) -> $12,000. Total -> $64,920. Will refine.
maddie: Add SLA credit language: if monthly p99 latency > target, 10% credit on monthly infra fee. Legal to sign.
claire: On the questionnaire, Omnifreight wants a contact for penetration test coordination. Raj, can you be the lead?
raj: I can do it. I'll schedule with their SecOps and share scope (no production credentials).
elena: They also asked for a short demo script for the POC: 1) ingest 50k historical tickets, 2) run embeddings, 3) surface reranker + conversation. Any concerns?
raj: For embeddings at that volume, enable batching and one-shot full-index build; we recommend quantized model for lower memory. Also allocate extra disk for indexing (~40GB).
tom: Noted. I'll update infra plan.
maddie: Anything blocking legal/finance?
elena: Legal needs the partnership co-sell addendum signed (we've started it), finance needs a purchase order threshold — they'll accept $50k PO for POC but sales wants to push the total to $65k.
maddie: Ok. I'll confirm with finance.
claire: One more thing: their compliance officer asked for a short runbook for incident escalation during the POC. I sketched steps; can someone turn that into a one-page runbook?
raj: I'll draft the runbook: include contact matrix (redwood oncall, eng-ml lead, customer sec), log collection commands, and rollback steps (switch routing to smaller model variant).
maddie: Perfect. Can we aim to send the full package (SAML metadata, security answers, pricing slide, runbook) to Omnifreight by EOD tomorrow?
elena: Yes, we'll target EOD. I'll prep the partner-facing slide deck.
tom: I'll finalize infra numbers and attach sample terraform snippet for peering:```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-omnifreight"
  vpc_id = "vpc-redwood-dedicated"
}
```
claire: Thanks. I'll also include the signed SAML cert once Raj provides the thumbprint.
raj: Uploading cert thumbprint to the secure notes channel now.
maddie: Awesome — thanks everyone. Follow-ups tomorrow after finance sign-off. :rocket:
